video_title: SERBIA COACH: "Nikola Jokic is OBSESSED with BASKETBALL, but the media doesn't KNOW THIS!

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the necessity of talent for a basketball coach
quotes.excerpt: I believe that to be a coach, you need the talent. You have to fight.
quotes.quote: I believe that to be a coach, you need the talent. You have to fight, you have to struggle, you have to prove yourself over and over and again and again. You are the guy who is pushing that bar on the next level every year. But I believe that I have a talent for a basketball coach.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on turning around the fortunes of Beşiktaş
quotes.excerpt: The year before it was almost relegation for the Beşiktaş. We came next year three semifinals immediately.
quotes.quote: The year before it was almost relegation for the Beşiktaş. We came next year three semifinals immediately in our next year. But these fans, they know to respect when you give 101%, doesn't matter what.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on defining success for underdog versus high-budget teams
quotes.excerpt: Success is a different in the eyes of different people.
quotes.quote: Success is a different in the eyes of different people. So if you go for a high budget teams then success is only to win some championships, medals. When you work with some, let's say, underdog teams, then success can be much more. God gives you exactly how much you can take on your back. Everything will be like a God wants to be.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the challenges of becoming the Serbian national team coach
quotes.excerpt: This coaching school in Serbia is a very, very big one and very respectful all over the world.
quotes.quote: This coaching school in Serbia is a very, very big one and very respectful all over the world. So it's not happening overnight. There is a lot of people who are following this, there is a lot of people who are following your work and it's not only about working with big budget teams. We have in Serbia a lot of good coaches who are working on EuroCup level, EuroLeague level, Champions League level.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the hard work behind coaching success
quotes.excerpt: Nothing comes over the night. It's a lot of hard work behind that.
quotes.quote: Nothing comes over the night. It's a lot of hard work behind that. A lot of stressful nights and years. Success is a different in the eyes of different people. So if you go for a high budget teams then success is only to win some championships, medals. When you work with some, let's say, underdog teams, then success can be much more. I had this luck to be honest and I'm very proud of that that I'm working lately with teams that you can see immediately some growing up of these teams that I coach.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the struggle of coaches without a playing career
quotes.excerpt: You have to fight, you have to struggle, you have to prove yourself over and over.
quotes.quote: You have to fight, you have to struggle, you have to prove yourself over and over and again and again. You are the guy who is pushing that bar on the next level every year. Before I took Red Star as a 32 young boy, I had Pero Antić. It was very interesting with Pero Antić. It was for a book.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the importance of dedication and preparation for coaches
quotes.excerpt: First of all, your dedication. Everybody can see immediately your dedication that you are living this job.
quotes.quote: First of all, your dedication. Everybody can see immediately your dedication that you are living this job. If you come unprepared for the meeting or for the practice or you don't have answers on their questions, this is immediately like a stop for everybody. They don't see you anymore with the same eyes. That dedication is very important and everybody can see that.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on maintaining consistent discipline for all players
quotes.excerpt: I believe that I stick to some same rules.
quotes.quote: I believe that I stick to some same rules. Of course, we have different roles, as I said. Of course, that we place some sets on a different way for these players and that players. Of course, they need to know their roles. Of course, we need to know who is main ball handler, who is scorer, who is main defender. But in terms of discipline for everybody same.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on prioritizing character over talent in player recruitment
quotes.excerpt: Main thing is a good character. I really like good character guys. I choose good character over talent.
quotes.quote: Main thing is a good character. I really like good character guys. I choose good character over talent. Talent is important. When we call for some player, of course we watch already a lot of games. We already knew him from this or that angle, but at the end of the day, if it's like 5 to 10% like a less talented than another player that we are choosing between them, then for sure I will go over over character more than than anything else.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the importance of character in player development
quotes.excerpt: I remember that Tarik Biberović. He was the guy that everybody told me don't take him.
quotes.quote: I remember that Tarik Biberović. He was the guy that everybody told me don't take him, very problematic guy, cannot defend, cannot make anything. I believe that you know in that moment that was a right decision for us to take him because I had one conversation phone call with him. I never, I never sign a player before I talk to him sometimes more than one time. I always want to be clear to tell him very openly, listen, this kind of things I'm doing, I'm yelling, I'm pushing, I'm doing a lot of things, but it's for your good.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the advantage of having a network of Serbian coaches
quotes.excerpt: Whoever comes from Serbia, we have a lot of coaches that we can call them in any time.
quotes.quote: Whoever comes from Serbia, we have a lot of coaches that we can call them in any time. And I think this is a huge advantage. I have a lot of conversations with Pešić lately. I had also a lot of conversations with Željko, of course. I was going to watch his practices in time when he was even in Fenerbahçe.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the necessity of obsession for coaching success
quotes.excerpt: Do you think you have to be obsessed with basketball to be successful in this job? Yes.
quotes.quote: Do you think you have to be obsessed with basketball to be successful in this job? Yes. It happened just like this. Like we said, in a very, very early phase of my life, I got that answer, okay, this is what I want to what what I want to do. I go from the from the scratch. I go with with the youth first.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the difference between players and coaches
quotes.excerpt: What is the main difference between player and the coach? Player finished the game, shower, go with family.
quotes.quote: What is the main difference between player and the coach? Player finished the game, shower, go with family, girlfriend, wife, whatever. They go in a restaurant, good food, good drink, rest, go tomorrow on a practice and let's hear again from the coach what you will play. With us it's a totally different thing. So, not just me, whole my coaching staff. I'm not talking only about head coaches. This is in every club same, in every team same. Assistant coaches are doing amazing job.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the coaching success of Ergin Ataman
quotes.excerpt: Ataman is special and look, Ataman has his own thing and I believe that this is by far.
quotes.quote: Ataman is special and look, Ataman has his own thing and I believe that this is by far best Turkish coach, but not just Turkish coach, I believe that in last five years, he is best European coach. He proved that, yeah. Results are behind him. If he likes to go to beach, I support, you know, because the results are there, trophies are there, you know, championships are there with the different clubs, different championships. Nobody like him, nobody like him.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the challenges of managing player availability in national teams
quotes.excerpt: I had in this national team of Turkey, I had three players. Zero calls to coach.
quotes.quote: I had in this national team of Turkey, I had three players. Zero calls to coach or to anyone in a club. They send, they are on a list, they go. If you go with with us, so we can we can even make it. So, FS play a game in a Belgrade two days before our first game. Players stayed, no one asked, they stayed and they play. Coach Ataman and Jeddy, they came by plane after midnight, night before our our game. So, there is also consistency and continuation of that work. They are many years together, they are collecting these people, you know, with a reason because they feel they feel this national team on a right way, they feel this country on a right way.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the difference between US and European coaching systems
quotes.excerpt: In Europe still we have some coaching, a game there is absolutely player's game.
quotes.quote: In Europe still we have some coaching, a game there is absolutely player's game, much more, I mean the best players in the world are there in NBA. It's much more talent, it's a different kind of basketball, everything is more simple from the coaching side. Not everyone, there is still amazing, amazing ideas, systems, offenses. By the way, we are stealing also from them a lot. So, it's not a big secret. We are going to we are going to watch a college to take something which will come in Europe in five years.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the physical and athletic superiority of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I believe not. Still NBA will be much more in advantage because of physicality, their athletic possibilities.
quotes.quote: I believe not. Still NBA will be much more in advantage because of physicality, their athletic possibilities. I believe that it it will be always faster, you know, higher, stronger. But in Europe it's a it's a different mentality. It's I mean for me it's not even comparable, you know. We are talking that basketball it's the same language everywhere in the world but for me it's not, you know. There is no chance that that passion and and the fans desire and the the this is like style of life. It's not like, you know, you just go and watch the game, you know.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the challenge of coaching the Serbian national team
quotes.excerpt: Taking Serbia, it's challenge for itself, you know.
quotes.quote: Taking Serbia, it's challenge for itself, you know. If I believe that everybody will agree that Serbian national team still in three best national teams all over the world. So everybody knows when you say Serbia, everybody knows. How long it will be, we don't know because pool of players are different, smaller, basketball change, you know, a lot of other countries develop their their basketball level on another level.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the lack of communication between clubs and federations
quotes.excerpt: Communication with the clubs from Federation side doesn't exist for this kind of things.
quotes.quote: Communication with the clubs from Federation side doesn't exist for this kind of things. Send a letter, here is a beginning of our camp, end of story. There is no, you know, communication begging forward. They are, they are, so I said this already example that I had in this national team of Turkey, I had three players. Zero calls to coach or to any one in a club. They send, they are on a list, they go.

quotes.speaker: Dušan Alimpijević
quotes.summary_phrase: Dušan Alimpijević on the coaching legacy of Ergin Ataman
quotes.excerpt: Coach Ataman wanted even before this last European Championship to make it over.
quotes.quote: Coach Ataman wanted even before this last European Championship to make it over. But players wanted him. He had amazing success before, championship before. He created this chemistry and atmosphere between them again, well known good one, you know, for Serbia, that everybody knows us also about this chemistry that we have. And he get them around again, you know, on a best possible way. So, they wanted him and I believe that he decided to stay because of the players.
